bridge.from_prev: Rhea files a metaphysical grievance through the Ledger.
bridge.to_next: The overseer retaliates using administrative debt mechanics.

chapters.goal: Execute a mid-level exploit that forces the system to refund stolen XP/loot, drawing the ire of the local frontier overseer.

sections.end_condition: Rhea successfully submits the grievance, triggering an automated System freeze on the local node's assets.
sections.intent: Rhea drafts and submits a metaphysical grievance using the Ledger's own obscure audit rules.

scenes.outcome: Rhea successfully formats the grievance using the correct administrative syntax.
scenes.summary: Still in the Maintenance Trenches, Rhea uses the locked data crystal to draft a formal metaphysical grievance. She forces Unit 734 to provide the exact bureaucratic syntax required to bypass local filters and send the complaint directly to the Ledger's core audit sub-routine.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea holds the pulsing data crystal up to the dim amber light of the Maintenance Trenches, demanding Unit 734 project the Ledger's core grievance forms.
scenes.transition_out_text: She finalizes the glowing text block, her finger hovering over the execution rune etched into the terminal.

scenes.end_condition_echo: Rhea successfully submits the grievance, triggering an automated System freeze on the local node's assets.
scenes.outcome: Rhea successfully submits the grievance, triggering an automated System freeze on the local node's assets.
scenes.summary: Rhea submits the grievance. The system immediately registers the discrepancy and initiates an automated freeze on the local node's assets. The terminal locks down, and warning klaxons blare as the environment shifts into an active audit state.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea slams her palm against the execution rune, sending the glowing text block spiraling into the brass terminal's core.
scenes.transition_out_text: The klaxons shift to a deafening, rhythmic pulse as the heavy iron blast doors begin to grind open toward the surface.

sections.title: Filing the Grievance

sections.end_condition: The party survives the chaotic influx of refunded power and levels up significantly.
sections.intent: The System processes the audit, violently refunding the stolen XP and loot to the party in the middle of a hostile zone.

scenes.outcome: The party is caught in a dangerous, physical storm of refunded System value.
scenes.summary: Fleeing the locked-down trenches, the party emerges onto the Outpost Surface just as the System begins processing the refund. The sky turns a violent, glitching purple, and raw XP and loot begin raining down on them in physical, concussive bursts.
scenes.transition_in_text: Vance kicks the grinding blast doors apart, dragging Rhea out onto the ash-covered surface of the Outpost.
scenes.transition_out_text: A jagged shard of crystallized experience points shatters against Vance's shield, knocking him back into the dirt.

scenes.outcome: Rhea and Vance rapidly allocate stats and manage inventory to survive the violent influx of rewards.
scenes.summary: The refund becomes a hazard. The sheer volume of back-paid XP and physical items threatens to crush them or overload their physical capacities. Rhea has to rapidly allocate stats and manage inventory space on the fly to prevent a fatal system overload.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea drops to her knees in the dirt, frantically swiping through her flashing inventory screens as heavy iron ingots materialize out of thin air.
scenes.transition_out_text: She confirms the final stat allocation, gasping as the crushing pressure of unspent experience points finally dissipates from her chest.

scenes.end_condition_echo: The party survives the chaotic influx of refunded power and levels up significantly.
scenes.outcome: The party survives the chaotic influx of refunded power and levels up significantly.
scenes.summary: The storm of value subsides. The party stands amidst a crater of refunded loot, having leveled up significantly. They take a moment to assess their new stats and the sheer absurdity of surviving a bureaucratic payout.
scenes.transition_in_text: The violent purple sky snaps back to a dull gray, leaving the party standing in a smoking crater filled with scattered coins and glowing pelts.
scenes.transition_out_text: Vance hefts his newly upgraded iron bludgeon, staring warily at the administrative spire looming in the distance.

sections.title: The Violent Refund

sections.end_condition: The party receives a red-tier 'Audit Compliance' warning directly from the overseer.
sections.intent: The local overseer realizes what happened and manually overrides the automated system to target Rhea.

scenes.outcome: The local overseer manually overrides the system and identifies Rhea as the source of the audit.
scenes.summary: The automated freeze is suddenly overridden. The local overseer, realizing the node's assets have been frozen, manually forces a connection to Rhea's party. Unit 734's chassis is hijacked to project a massive, furious avatar of the overseer.
scenes.transition_in_text: Unit 734 suddenly convulses, its optical lens projecting a blinding red beam that paints the ash-covered ground.
scenes.transition_out_text: The projected avatar glares down at Rhea, its voice booming with the unmistakable weight of administrative authority.

scenes.end_condition_echo: The party receives a red-tier 'Audit Compliance' warning directly from the overseer.
scenes.outcome: The party receives a red-tier 'Audit Compliance' warning directly from the overseer.
scenes.summary: The overseer issues a direct threat, bypassing standard dialogue to slap the party with a red-tier 'Audit Compliance' warning. This debuff marks them as hostile to the local environment, setting the stage for a brutal counter-attack.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea stands her ground beneath the towering red projection, crossing her arms as the overseer's avatar begins to dictate the terms of their punishment.
scenes.transition_out_text: The red projection collapses back into the drone, leaving a burning crimson warning icon permanently etched into the corner of Rhea's vision.
